diagnosis: The CQRS query handler reads the complete event history stream for patientId directly from EventStoreDB without verifying that the requesting clinical staff member is assigned to that patient. Any hospital worker can stream comprehensive psychiatric diagnoses, surgical histories, and prescription events of arbitrary patients.
exploit_request:
GET /api/queries/patients/pat_vip_881902/history HTTP/1.1
Host: cqrs.healthrecords.internal
Authorization: Bearer <staff_member_token>
